children: UAB "Kvartalas" asks bondholders to extend maturity from 19 December 2026 to 2 April 2027. If approved, the final-period annual interest rate would rise from 8% to 9%; bank-loan funding may not arrive before the current maturity.
Maturity extension to 2 April 2027 requires approval
Bondholders must approve the change; it delays repayment beyond the current 19 December 2026 maturity.
Final-period annual rate would rise from 8% to 9%
The proposed increase compensates bondholders for the extension, but applies only to the final interest period.
Bank loan may not arrive before current maturity
The company says loan proceeds are intended to redeem the bonds, but timing creates repayment uncertainty.
Business centre occupancy is 89% under signed leases
The project is generating revenue, though the release provides no revenue figure or prior-period comparison.
Bonds remain secured by a first-ranking mortgage
The stated collateral remains unchanged under the proposal.

This is a near-term refinancing and bond-maturity decision, with the company reporting the project is complete and generating revenue. Bondholder approval and the timing and disbursement of the proposed bank loan are the next key developments.
